How much does it cost to replace a garage door opener? Garage door opener replacement on the Gold Coast generally costs between $400 and $900 supplied and installed, depending on motor brand, lifting capacity and smart-home features. Basic chain-drive units are at the lower end; quiet belt-drive or battery-backup models are at the higher end. Do you come to Palm Beach and Currumbin for garage door repairs? Yes. Palm Beach, Currumbin and Elanora are covered. Coastal salt air is hard on garage door springs and cables in this corridor, so we often recommend rust-resistant hardware and more frequent servicing for beachside homes. How much does it cost to repair a garage door? Most common residential repairs on the Gold Coast sit between $150 and $500 including parts and labour. A simple roller replacement or track adjustment is usually at the lower end; spring or motor replacement is at the higher end. Commercial roller doors and custom parts can cost more. The repairer taking on your job provides a firm written quote before any work starts. How much does it cost to get a garage door service? A standard garage door service on the Gold Coast typically costs between $150 and $220, depending on door type, height and accessibility. The service includes lubrication, tension check, safety beam test, remote check and a written condition report. How much does a roller door repair cost on the Gold Coast? Roller door repairs usually range from $200 to $400. Minor issues such as a snapped cable or bent curtain slat are cheaper; motor or drum replacement pushes the price higher.
